spec.name: sprint33_taker_imbalance_majors_10m
spec.hypothesis: Short-horizon taker buy/sell volume imbalance in BTCUSD/ETHUSD predicts net-of-cost price drift over the following 10 minutes on T1-liquidity majors — isolates the new order-flow signal from the tail-liquidity cost drag that dominated sprint31/32.
spec.power_argument: sprint31/32 imply per-trade net-bps stdev ~72-111bps in the illiquid altbasket, driven mainly by slippage; T1 majors should have materially lower variance. At n=300 and a conservative stdev=72bps, min detectable edge ~2*72/sqrt(300)=8.3bps net at t~2. entry_per_day_cap=6 x 2 symbols over the sealed test window should comfortably clear n>=300 qualifying trades (sprint31/32 cleared 4000+ on a similar cap x basket).
